I read the finding in findings.json (still OPEN, one history entry) and in round-5/qa-verifier.findings.json, the BE-Z8 handback and the diff d7b21bad..031945d8 of apps/api/src/modules/operations/exceptions.ts and apps/worker/src/kit.ts. The change is one expression in each raise path: last_occurred_at = greatest(now(), operational_exception.last_occurred_at), so the stored value is read in SQL (microseconds) instead of being round-tripped through a millisecond JavaScript Date. occurrence_count is still current.occurrence_count + 1 under the advisory lock, the FOR UPDATE read and WHERE version = current.version, and the 0101 guard is unchanged (no migration, no retry, no upsert). No other monotonic timestamp is written from a JavaScript value (grep of apps/*/src). My round-5 Q2 (20 concurrent API raises on one open exception, 5 rounds): 0 rejected, 21/21 occurrences, 20/20 recurred events. The in-tree concurrent-exception-recurrence.test.ts passed 7/7 in the same run (10a, exit 0).
